story: An icon of the skies, the Abyssinian Owl (Asio abyssinicus) is a species from the Strigidae family. It thrives in Open grasslands; moorlands; montane forests; mountain valleys; and gorges up to 3900 m, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Abyssinian Owl is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Abyssinian Owl helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Abyssinian Owl, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
